title: Generic type constraint violation

sourceOfTruth.rule: Read the exact generic constraint from the compiler error or installed DLL.

symptoms: A type cannot be used as a generic parameter because there is no implicit reference conversion.
DTO type supplied where Core model type is required.
investigation: Read the failing type parameter and required constraint from the error.
Decompile the generic declaration if the compiler output is incomplete.
Find every occurrence of the wrong type in class declarations and DI registrations.
patchRules: Use the type that satisfies the decompiled constraint.
Prefer Core.Model types when the constraint is Core.Model.X.
Apply the same correction consistently across DI and generic base declarations.
antiPatterns: Do not silence the error with casts.
Do not swap to a client DTO when the constraint names a Core model.
Do not change generic constraints in client code to avoid the package contract.

successCriteria: No CS0305 arity errors remain for the same generic type.
